evidence: Labeled Wallet and modifies wallet descriptor import and rescan behavior in ScanFromTime.
rationale: Fixes a bug where importdescriptors falsely reports success if interrupted by node shutdown, silently leaving historical transactions missing from the wallet. As noted in the description, when stopped during a rescan, 'the call still returns success for descriptors whose history was not scanned', and because the best block is recorded at the chain tip, the wallet will not automatically rescan on restart, causing wrong balances without user warning.
